Scene 9 — 6s

EXT. ROOFTOP — LATE AFTERNOON

Warm light spills across a rooftop garden above the traffic. Scarlett walks between concrete planters carrying the flowers, then places the lipstick on the ledge beside them. A train rattles along the elevated track below; its vibration makes the tube tremble slightly as the camera pushes in, city reflections skating across the casing.

---

## Scene 10 — ROOFTOP
EXT. ROOFTOP — CONTINUOUS
duration: 6s
shots: exactly 1

Scene 10 — 6s

EXT. ROOFTOP — CONTINUOUS

Scarlett picks up the lipstick before the wind can carry it away and slips it into her pocket. She turns toward the skyline, coral flowers tucked against her shoulder, and the train flashes behind her in a bright moving band. She looks back at camera, smiles with effortless certainty, and walks out of frame as the loose petals lift and swirl in the late light.
